text:
deploy-bot: Starting config-only rollout: routing/v2 -> canary 5% (eng-prod). Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Key params: per_tenant_rate_floor=10, per_tenant_rate_cap=100, batch_window_ms: 25 -> 15. Pin model variants to v1.3-q4. Runbook: https://go/release/runbooks/routing-v2-config. CI: https://ci.internal/4567
sam: ack, I'll watch latency and error-rate during canary. Will call if p99 moves > 150ms or errors > 1.5%
jen: quick q — pin to v1.3-q4 means no kernel upgrade in this rollout, right?
sam: correct — we keep model binary fixed. Fallback configured to v1.2-stable if healthcheck fails.
claire: propose rollback thresholds: p99 latency increase > 200ms sustained over 5m OR error rate > 2% over 5m. Also CPU GPU mem pressure > 85% on serving nodes for 5m.
dave: seeing slight KV cache pressure on staging last night after batch_window change. Any extra observability hooks we want?
sam: add a KV cache hit/miss dashboard to the watchlist. Do NOT change batch_window mid-canary without coordination.
dave: got it — won't touch.
jen: documenting rollback action: run `deploy rollback --config routing/v2 --reason "p99+200ms or err>2%"` and notify #incidents and oncall. Also include trace-id sample for triage.
claire: add a post-rollout smoke test at +15m after each step (simple prompt/response check and healthcheck).
deploy-bot: Canary reached 5% at +5m. Metrics snapshot: p50=85ms, p95=120ms, p99=170ms, errors=0.7%. KV cache hit 92%. No alerts. Live observability: https://obs.internal/dashboards/routing-v2?canary
sam: looks clean so far. I'll hit the 25m mark and re-evaluate.
dave: FYI I opened a tiny spike alert on staging earlier but irrelevant to prod canary.
jen: reminder to tag release notes: "config: routing/v2 - tighter batching, new per-tenant floors/caps, model pin v1.3-q4"
claire: schedule posted to calendar for post-deploy smoke @ 23:15 UTC — pinged SRE.
deploy-bot: Canary complete at +25m with no anomalies. Proceeding with gradual ramp: 25% -> 50% -> 75% -> 100% over 2h, 30m pauses between steps. Auto-rollback conditions active. Release notes: https://changelog.internal/releases/2026-03-routing-v2-config
sam: :thumbsup: I'll monitor each step and call for rollback if thresholds trigger.
dave: I'll keep the KV cache dashboard open and watch for tail latency.
jen: if anything looks off run `deploy rollback --config routing/v2` and then tag the incident.
claire: post-deploy smoke test scheduled after each step, first run at 23:15 UTC.
sam: closing thread here unless anyone wants to flag pre-ramp concerns. Good to go.
